messages:
zoe: hey team — first day here, trying to run the sample repo CI pipeline but Buildkite job is failing when it tries to read secrets from Vault. error shows '403 Forbidden: token does not have access to secret path'. any on-call vault wizard available?

sam: welcome! which repo are you running? did you install the GitHub App and accept org SSO? sometimes that blocks role mapping.

zoe: repo is infra/ci-samples. I installed the app (I can see it under my apps) and I joined the 'ci-team' group per onboarding. job log has this snippet: 
```
Error: vault kv get secret/ci/infra: permission denied
path: secret/ci/infra
operation: read
```

elaine: ah ok — common pitfall. New hires often use a personal static token or `vault login` which doesn't get the ci role mapping. We use `dev-auth` to mint short-lived tokens mapped to CI policies. Try: `dev-auth login --role=ci-buildkite` then re-run. docs: https://internal.redwood.dev/onboarding/ci-auth

zoe: I used my personal token, oops. is `dev-auth` on the path by default?

sam: yes, it's installed via the dotfiles script. if you didn't run `bootstrap-dotfiles` it might not be. command is `bootstrap-dotfiles && dev-auth login --role=ci-buildkite`. That sets up the token with policy `ci-build-policy`.

zoe: running it now...

ci-bot: buildkite: job #42 started by zoe — pulling steps and attempting to fetch secrets

zoe: still hitting 403 after dev-auth. copying the full log: 
```
[2026-03-23T15:12:04Z] vault: kv get secret/ci/infra -> 403 Forbidden
message: permission denied
principal: user:zoe@redwood.com
policies: [default]
```

infra-oncall: @zoe I can see your principal in Vault — it only has the default policy. Looks like SSO mapping didn't sync your org group to the ci role. Give me a minute, I'll add the `ci-build-policy` to your principal.

infra-oncall: ok done — I pushed the mapping and triggered a token refresh for your session. re-run the Buildkite job or re-trigger the pipeline from the UI.

zoe: re-ran the job, and it's green now! thanks everyone :tada:

sam: nice. quick follow-up: if you accept org SSO after the first login, run `dev-auth sync` to pull group membership changes into Vault mapping. otherwise the role binding can lag.

zoe: awesome, where's that note in the onboarding doc? I couldn't find the `dev-auth sync` tip.

elaine: good point — I'll add a short section to the onboarding checklist for new hires to run `bootstrap-dotfiles` and `dev-auth sync` after SSO. linking the PR once done.

zoe: thanks again — saved my morning :)
